pages.title: Overvieww
pages.purpose: Introduce the Domain For Sale landing page project: purpose (let prospective buyers submit offers for a domain), the static HTML + PHP mail architecture, file inventory, and links to child pages.

pages.title: Getting Started & Configuration
pages.purpose: How to clone, host on a PHP-capable web server, and replace placeholders (page title, price, email, phone, owner name) in index.html and contact.php. Includes reCAPTCHA key setup.

pages.title: Request & Offer Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end flow: visitor loads index.html, client-side validation, reCAPTCHA, POST to contact.php, sanitization, mail() dispatch, confirmation page render.

pages.title: Frontend Landing Page
pages.purpose: Overview of the client-side layer: markup structure, styling, and client-side scripts. Links to child pages.

pages.title: index.html Structure & Offer Form
pages.purpose: Detail the two-column hero layout, branding/contact panel, pricing CTA, and the #main-offer-form fields (name, email, phone, price, comments) and their attributes.

pages.title: Styling System (css/style.css)
pages.purpose: Typography (Mukta Mahee), .hero/.height-100/.col-fixed layout geometry, form-control styling, color & icon utility classes, button variants, responsive breakpoints.

pages.title: Client-Side Validation
pages.purpose: How jQuery Validate is configured against #main-offer-form: rules, messages, highlight/unhighlight hooks, .has-danger and form-control-feedback error rendering.

pages.title: jQuery Validate Plugin Internals
pages.purpose: Reference on the bundled js/jquery.validate.min.js: $.fn.validate, a.validator, rule resolution, built-in methods, remote/pending state, errorMap/errorList.

pages.title: Bundled jQuery Library
pages.purpose: Role of js/jquery.min.js (v1.10.2): global $/jQuery, Sizzle selectors, event dispatch, Deferred, AJAX — and why it is vendored locally.

pages.title: PHP Backend
pages.purpose: Overview of the server-side components that process offer submissions and verify bot challenges. Links to child pages.

pages.title: contact.php Submission Handler
pages.purpose: POST parameter extraction, clean_string sanitization against header injection, email body/header assembly, mail() dispatch, and the HTML confirmation view it renders.

pages.title: reCAPTCHA Verification Library
pages.purpose: ReCaptcha and ReCaptchaResponse classes in recaptchalib.php: secret handling, _encodeQS, _submitHTTPGet to siteverify, JSON response parsing, missing-input short-circuit.

pages.title: Security Considerations
pages.purpose: Header-injection sanitization limits, suppressed mail errors (@mail), hardcoded recipient and site keys, client-vs-server validation gaps, and whether reCAPTCHA is actually enforced server-side.

pages.title: Project Meta
pages.purpose: Non-code assets: documentation and licensing. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Documentation (README)
pages.purpose: Content and intent of README.md: feature claims, deployment phases, configuration checklist.

pages.title: License & Attribution
pages.purpose: MIT License terms (Copyright 2021 Saroz Poddar), redistribution conditions, warranty disclaimer, and attribution of CDN-hosted third-party assets.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Define codebase-specific terms with code pointers: #main-offer-form, clean_string, ReCaptcha/ReCaptchaResponse, siteverify, missing-input, .col-fixed, .hero, .vMiddle, .bg-faded, .has-danger, form-control-feedback, onSubmit callback, g-recaptcha, validator instance, errorMap/errorList, normalizer, dependency-mismatch, Sizzle, Deferred, Mukta Mahee, Ionicons, Animate.css, btn-radius, icon-lg/md/sm, purchaser, Instant Purchase CTA.
